identity: Lorindor's berry woods and pearl shore pay their tolls twice: to netters in the woods at night and to mirefolk who count pearls that were never theirs.

quests.title: Cut the Snares
quests.text: The birds have gone quiet because somebody has been busy with cord beneath them. Cut the snare bundle at the {name:snare_ground} in the {name:berrywoods}. I want the carriers to hear birds again when they walk these paths.

variants.text: The birds have gone quiet because somebody has been busy with cord beneath them. Cut the snare bundle at the {name:snare_ground} in the {name:berrywoods}. I want the carriers to hear birds again when they walk these paths.

Someone has marked a snare ground as if it were under a warden's care, which is an inventive use of the word. Cut the snare bundle at the {name:snare_ground} in the {name:eaves}. My observers should be able to follow a forest sign without stepping into somebody's business.

quests.lesson: A use at a recipe place in the open: the same act in two woods.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Schlingen lösen' (K9 A): the snare grounds of Lorindor's Berrywoods and Moonfall's Eaves.

quests.title: A Taste After a Long Road
quests.text: The harvesters and carriers bring good food to other people's tables, then sit down to whatever survived in their packs. Bring me six Marshbloom for their meal here. I would like the people who carried the harvest to taste something worth carrying.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Why the Wood Goes Quiet
quests.text: The carriers say the birds fall silent on stretches of their usual paths. Speak to Orya Petalward at Petalbank Wardenry about it. She knows when a quiet wood is resting and when something has given it reason to be quiet.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Harvest Worth Packing
quests.text: I can name the household waiting for each harvest load, but that knowledge does little for berries crushed in a split crate. Bring me three Chests for the goods leaving Berrycourt. I will pack them properly and keep the recipient's name with the load.
quests.lesson: A use at a place or a day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Word With Kelda
quests.text: Kelda Screesort at Tarncut Mine in Frostbarrow Shelf judges a day's work by how safely her people come out of it. Go and speak to her if you can lend a hand. We work very different ground, but I would trust her beneath any roof I had braced.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: What Never Reaches Highcourt
quests.text: Our delivery accounts say the harvest left Lorindor, while the people waiting for it tell another story. Take word to Mariel Waybook in Highcourt. I want someone at that end asking about the missing food as carefully as they ask about the paperwork.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: The Other End of the Basket Trade
quests.text: Merren Oakstamp at Whitebridge Market Close knows whose table each of our baskets is meant to reach. Go and speak to her about the loads coming from Lorindor. A delivery is unfinished while its intended supper is still somebody else's stock.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Lights for the Wardens' Rounds
quests.text: My wardens walk the carriers' paths after dark, when a cord across the way is easy to miss. Bring me twenty Torches for their rounds. We will keep the flames clear of the undergrowth; I would like to protect the wood without first setting it alight.
quests.lesson: A later errand or use; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Close the Pearl Account
quests.text: Mirefolk Pearl-Counter Iss takes a share of every load he can stop and calls it the price of letting our harvest pass. Kill him at the {name:pearl_camp}, {dir_from_giver:pearl_camp}, and return to me. He has found a profitable way to harvest a field he never planted.
quests.completion: Iss's share ends here. I can account for a full load again and put the names of its waiting recipients beside it.
quests.lesson: The named leader; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: The Road to Ashenward
quests.text: Toren Waterbarrel keeps the people at Cinderline Watch supplied in Ashenward March. Go and speak to him if you can help. A harvest matters just as much to someone standing watch as it does to someone setting a table.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The departure id stays; free from 29, it requires nothing.
